name: stackgen
description: The principles-driven stack materializer — implements the vwf stack-adapter contract with a dispatch rule over bundles: a bundle names the bootstrap tools it needs and its knowledge packs; a pack it lists is copied verbatim, a @generated ref is generated (per-topic research, Context7 first when Context7 is installed, else the official documentation and the package registries → vwf's principles catalog → the stackgen-skill-reviewer gate, capped at four rounds), and bootstrap adds the tools. Tool knowledge — the doctrine of a language, a package manager or a gate, keyed by bootstrap tool — follows the tools and is never picked. A combination no bundle covers is composed into a repo bundle. A materialization lands in the repo's committed .claude/ tree — skills, agents, hooks and rules — plus, for packs that ship one, a config/ tree mirroring the repo root. The generated local plugin vwf-tools, outside the repo, holds the LSP servers bootstrap lsp prints and the design tools — generic design-import role skills with one reference per tool — that a repo's projects name. stackgen installs no MCP server and no Claude plugin: MCP servers are the user's to install, and an addon is a Claude plugin bootstrap installs. Every artifact is shaped by a closed kind vocabulary, recorded per component in a lockfile, editable and plugin-independent for collaborators. Re-sync is explicit, per component and lockfile-diffed, never silent. Ships curated knowledge packs, bundles, tool knowledge and design tools, inventoried in stacks/inventory.md. assets/artifact-doctrine.md carries the host rules deciding whether a generated skill, agent or hook is valid at all, and assets/contracts/ the provider-neutral capability doctrine each category is compared against. .claude/settings.json is written only behind its own explicit consent line, merging never owning.
